entries.name: Onam
entries.capsule: Kerala festival kept by the Minnesota Malayalee Association.
entries.dateRule: Thiruvonam, the day of the Thiruvonam star in the Malayalam month of Chingam (August or September). Kerala's government sets the public holiday each year; Minnesota groups pick their own weekend.

dates.source: Onmanorama (Oct. 29, 2025) reports that the Kerala government's 2026 holiday list gives Thiruvonam as Wednesday, Aug. 26, 2026. That is a newspaper report, not the government notice itself, and a Thiruvananthapuram Municipal Corporation holiday page opened Oct. 31, 2026 lists Thiruvonam on Sept. 4, 2026, so the date is left unconfirmed. Drik Panchang, a commercial calendar, also gives Aug. 26.
No official or organizer source found

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: A state-funded India Association report names the Minnesota Malayalee Association's Onam in its 2022 to 2023 program. The association's own site could not be opened, and no 2026 Minnesota Onam date was found.
